'''Ja'Boag''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] who served as head of the [[Rim Commercial Mining]] and oversaw operations on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moorjhone]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Ja'Boag placed a bounty on [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] and his brother [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], who had recently been revealed to be alive. The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] learned of this and sent [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Salmara]] and [[Judd]], along with Salmara's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Dray (Fallen Jedi)|Dray]], to [[Moorjhone]]. However, Maul and Opress also traveled to Moorjhone, and arrived before the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. After Ja'Boag and his security forces engaged the brothers, Maul and Opress slaughtered the security forces and [[Telekinesis/Legends|threw]] Ja'Boag off a balcony. The three Jedi arrived just in time, and Ja'Boag was saved when Salmara caught him with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Later, he was taken into custody and killed by the Sith brothers.
